appearance_facts.fact: Blue solid line with circular markers is labeled 'Refugees' in blue text on the left y-axis.
Red dashed line with square markers is labeled 'IDPs' in red text on the right y-axis.
X-axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks from 2000.0 to 2017.5.
The blue 'Refugees' line ends at the highest vertical position on the chart, slightly above the red 'IDPs' line at the 2017 mark.
Numeric labels '73925955' (red) and '11698236' (blue) are visible near the 2012-2013 data points.

public_definitions: Compare the 2017 number of people for Refugees and IDPs.
Open the displacement category follow-up record for the category with the larger 2017 count.
uncertain: The exact numerical values for the 2017 data points are not explicitly labeled on the chart, only their relative positions are visible.
The chart uses two different y-axes (left for Refugees, right for IDPs), so direct visual comparison of height does not directly compare magnitude without knowing the axis scales.
